title: Inside US-Israel fault lines on Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey
gist: A webinar landing page (no transcript) announcing an Al-Monitor panel held while Netanyahu was in Washington, framed around the premise that US-Israel divisions over Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey are actively straining the relationship under Trump.

insights.claim: Divisions between Washington and Israel over Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey are testing the US-Israel relationship under President Donald Trump, and coincided with Benjamin Netanyahu's return visit to Washington.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Three-way friction on Iran policy, Saudi normalization and Turkey is the variable behind Middle East risk pricing; daylight between Trump and Netanyahu changes the odds of both escalation and a Saudi-Israel deal.
insights.quote: how divisions over Iran, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey are testing the US-Israel relationship under President Donald Trump
insights.locator: With Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu back in Washington
